headline: BROWNING OUT THE LIGHTS: 207 IS A FELONY
subhead: Patrickreegs dropped a deuce-oh-seven on T Swift's Baddies while Stroud Boys forgot football exists.
matchOfTheWeek: Christian McCalfinjury sneaking past QAmon by 3.38 was the only matchup that mattered for the people clinging to playoff seeding. Turf Toe Joe went full Bengals-in-December with 25.36, but Kyle still lost because that's the QAmon brand — drop a banger from the dead rat era and somehow find a way to bow out by a field goal. Wunder backed in like a Toyota in a Costco parking lot, but a W's a W.
powerRankingsShakeup: Browning Out just stamped themselves as the team nobody wants to see in round one, while Stroud Boys scoring 67 in WEEK 14 is grounds for the league to investigate tanking, dynasty-rebuild claims be damned.
mainRecap:
Let's start at the top of the mountain: Browning Out hung 207.78. Two-hundred-and-seven. In a SuperFlex week where half the league couldn't crack 100, Patrickreegs got Michael Wilson — MICHAEL. WILSON. — going for 37.20, Puka throwing up a 35.70, and Harold Fannin casually dropping 29.40 at TE. Oh, and Tony Pollard put up 28.10 ON THE BENCH. You scored 207 and STILL left a starter-grade RB in street clothes. That's not a flex, that's a war crime against T Swift's Baddies, who put up 158.80 (a winning score in 4 other matchups) and got curb-stomped by 49. Tnicolle's Gibbs went for 37 and it meant absolutely nothing. Brutal.

Meanwhile in the morgue: Stroud Boys posted 67.62. SIXTY. SEVEN. Rub My Chubb didn't even need to try — BigD could've started his taxi squad and won by 30. bjewett, what are we doing here? Money Mill$ couldn't bail you out of this one, chief.

Little Peckers smoked Egbukkake 127-88 because szara's roster is currently a haunted house: Erick None lived up to his name, Insta Drop kept dropping, and The Mascot couldn't carry the corpse. Tee Higgins went 27.20 for 7BigPapi7 and Unc chipped in like he always does.

The Good Ladds survived OnlyFants by 3.26 because 3rd Overall Somehow dropped 37.84 — and ChrisCubby is staring at Blake Corum's 26.10 on his bench wondering if reincarnation is real. Aaron Rodgers also rotted on Mig's bench for 21.46, so even the winner deserves a slap.

McBridesStrangeWhiteHock edged Nut Olave Your Face by 9.94, but the real story is nickcelli leaving 45.12 on the bench. My Njigba popped for 28, Mike Gesicki put up 23.60 in his BACKPACK, and you still lost. Optimal lineup was 148. Do better, or don't, it's funnier this way.

weeklyAwards.title: Nuclear Strike of the Week
weeklyAwards.blurb: 207.78 with a 28-point bench RB — this is bullying disguised as fantasy football.

weeklyAwards.title: Did You Even Open The App?
weeklyAwards.blurb: 45.12 points on the bench in a 9.94-point loss is a special kind of self-own, nickcelli.

weeklyAwards.title: DNP — Did Not Participate
weeklyAwards.blurb: 67.62 in Week 14 is the fantasy equivalent of mailing in a blank exam and signing it 'Money Mill$.'

weeklyAwards.title: Backed In Like A U-Haul
weeklyAwards.blurb: Squeaked past QAmon by 3.38 and acted like he drew it up — congrats on outscoring one team this week, Wunder.
